description: The comments of a post, a page per call: public comments and replies with their author, text, place in the thread, and like and reply counts. Pass url: its link or ID. Price per successful page: Bluesky, Facebook, Hacker News, Instagram, Reddit, Rumble, Snapchat, Threads, TikTok, X, YouTube: 1 credit. LinkedIn: 1 credit (public page) or 5 credits (data partner). Follow next_cursor while it is set; a short page is not the end.

comment_id.description: Only on Snapchat. List this comment's replies instead of the Spotlight's comments: the id of a comment from this endpoint.

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the next page, or the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions, without platform, post_id, url, edited_at, is_edited, is_liked_by_author and is_by_post_author; full returns every field. Same price: ask for full in the first call when you need one of them.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to the endpoint's page size (its default and maximum; larger values are reduced to it). Omit it for the cheapest walk: a page costs the same whatever its limit.

max_age.description: Accept a cached response up to this many seconds old. Cache hits cost 0 credits. Omit to always fetch fresh.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. A request that would cost more answers insufficient_credits with details.reason max_credits, free, before the work that would cost more (a speech-to-text transcription, a data partner's lookup, results filled in). Omit it to be charged the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

platform.description: Optional: a link names its platform. Needed only for a bare ID.

replies.description: Only on Reddit. all (default): a walk returns the whole tree, every reply Reddit left behind a "more replies" link included (on the pages after the one that shows its parent).

since.description: Only on Bluesky, Facebook, Hacker News, Instagram, Reddit, Rumble, Snapchat, Threads, TikTok, X or YouTube. Only items at or after this time: RFC 3339 (2026-10-01T12:00:00Z) or a date (2026-10-01, midnight UTC).

sort.description: Only on Bluesky, Facebook, Hacker News, Reddit, Rumble or YouTube. Order of the results.

until.description: Only on Bluesky, Facebook, Hacker News, Instagram, Reddit, Rumble, Snapchat, Threads, TikTok, X or YouTube. Only items before this time (exclusive): RFC 3339 or a date (midnight UTC).

url.description: A link to the item (as shared: a mobile, short or share link works) or its ID.

name: list_comments
title: Comments of a post
